title: Founding Product Designer
description:
About Us & Our Mission

Bloom (YC S21) unlocks access for a new generation of Americans (ages 13 - 17) to start building wealth early through investing in the stock market. We believe that wealth inequality is one of America's most pressing issues, and that encouraging the next generation to build wealth early is the most effective way to tackle it.

We are incredibly excited to have the opportunity to make a generational impact in improving the financial future of the next generation. Our company is mission-driven, and we've just raised $3.3M from some of the best investors in the valley.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for a Founding Product Designer with a strong understanding of young Gen Z. We offer competitive salary & equity, and an opportunity to be at the forefront of a product that will impact millions of Americans. Our qualifications:

  • 1.5+ years of experience designing consumer products.

  • Previous work experience with consumer fintech/social products is preferred.

  • Strong understanding of Gen Z and consumer products for this particular demographic.

  • Remote, but flexible to relocate to the Bay Area in 6 - 12 months time.

  • UI/UX focus but generalist (affinity to brand design, design system, etc.)

Bloom is proud to be an equal employment workplace committed to promoting an inclusive work environment free of discrimination and harassment. By valuing inclusion and diversity of all forms, we strictly prohibit and do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, ancestry, citizenship, sexual orientation, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.
